hooks.name: Auto commit & push to branch on agent stop

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "cd 'c:\dev\awssouth\awssbg-scd2026-prototype'; if ((git status --porcelain).Length -eq 0) { Write-Output 'No changes to commit.'; exit 0 }; $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $branch = \"agent-work/$ts\"; git checkout -b $branch; git add -A; git commit -m \"chore: auto-commit agent work $ts\"; git push -u origin $branch"
